POST /pair.detector: hand | workpiece; omitted means hand for historical clients

POST /offer.sdp: sendonly video SDP, b=AS:1500 or less

POST /heartbeat.unknown_fields: rejected; old empty object remains supported

authentication: Visitor routes only: same-origin HTTPS; join consumes code; other visitor routes Authorization: Bearer token bound to origin and session. Never grants robot authority.
clock_probe: Optional heartbeat response echoes nonce/client_sent_ms/server_received_ms/server_sent_ms; next heartbeat may acknowledge once within 8s. At most 8 samples, 10s TTL; offset and RTT/2 uncertainty estimate only heartbeat_round_trip. Never a sensor capture-time certificate; capture_age_available/control_qualified remain false.
result: hand uses the existing VisionPipeline; workpiece feeds the existing VisionWorkspace HSV analyzer through one bounded raw-frame slot. Workstation /api/vision/workspace/state carries the same-frame image, objects, ROI/calibration and source identity; visitor heartbeat carries only bounded structured objects/observations, never image/video. Remote captured_at is null; received_at and age_basis=workstation_receive only describe receiver age. capture_age_available/control_valid are false regardless of heartbeat clock estimate. Remote industrial results support read-only find/count, never robot pick/place.
lifecycle: start/close belong to application resources; configure source invalidates old session; page exit leave; heartbeat expiry and track failure revoke peer and current owned pipeline
public_entry: state.public_origin and join_url only from explicit ELFIN_REMOTE_ORIGIN HTTPS origin whose host is in HUYAN_ALLOWED_HOSTS; otherwise null; no listener/certificate change
